_readme: Chain -> parent-ABN lookup for social_enterprises rows that are site-level shops of a known parent org.
Applied by scripts/apply-chain-parent-abns.mjs (dry-run by default, --apply to write).
Every ABN here must be VERIFIED before adding — acnc_charities query, ABR MatchingNames/AbnDetails API, or the org's own website on the directory record. Record how in verified_via.
match.state null = national entity (applies in any state). match.postcodes (optional) gates to specific shops where one brand has multiple regional operators (e.g. Lifeline).
Precedent: site rows carrying parent ABN is established (senvic 'Save the Children Op Shop - Ararat' -> 99008610035; 'Lifeline Warehouse' SA south-east -> 97272740804).
